'''January 2001 Utah tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in "Ghetto Valley", Utah in January 2001. [[Tom Ercanbrack]] won it. It is known from Casey Barson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1642">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-18-smeg-goes-to-ghetto-valley-take-1d1642/ smeg-goes-to-ghetto-valley-take-1], DeckTech (Casey "Smeg" Barson, 18 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-18-smeg-goes-to-ghetto-valley-take-1d1642/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' January 2001
* '''Site:''' "Ghetto Valley", Utah
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Tom Ercanbrack]]
